about_the_game:
"Tavern in the Woods" is a single-player, first-person, story-driven mystery.

You take on the role of a weary traveler, and your journey has led you down an unfamiliar path through sparse and lonely countryside—a forgotten wilderness. At last, you arrive at an ancient tavern, nestled deep within the encroaching woods. Your heart weighs heavy with doubt—will there be room for you to rest? But as you step inside, you find only silence, an empty place, and a lingering mystery waiting in the shadows.

Gameplay:

You assume the role of a first-person protagonist, exploring the environment as the story gradually unfolds.

This is a work of interactive fiction that immerses you in a haunted landscape.

Key Features:

  • Atmosphere: An immersive, medieval-era setting—you arrive at the tavern late at night only to find it deserted. With no horse, no weapons, and only the expectation of a meal and a bed, your evening takes an unsettling turn.

  • No Combat: The game focuses on atmosphere, exploration and narrative. Combat is not required, though you may be witness to it!

  • Investigation: Where has everyone gone? Is a dark supernatural force at work? Uncover the truth through careful exploration.

Additional Technical Details:

  • Game Duration: 30 minutes to 1 hour (or 2–3 hours for thorough explorers).

  • No Save Function: Due to the short playtime, saving is not currently implemented.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains elements of horror and the supernatural. It is not suited to young children or kids.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX970 / Amd RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX9c compliant
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX9c compliant
  • VR Support: None
